text:
Predicates:
MondayAt8PM(x) ::: x is a Monday at 8 pm.
GivenOutOnTV(y) ::: y is given out on TV.
Rose(y) ::: y is a rose.
OnBachelor(z) ::: z is on the Bachelor.
PortraysRealPeople(w) ::: w portrays the lives of real people.
RealityTV(w) ::: w is a reality TV show.
BreakingBad ::: Breaking Bad (a specific show).
Premises:
∀x ∀y (MondayAt8PM(x) ∧ GivenOutOnTV(y) ∧ Rose(y) → MondayAt8PM(x) ∧ GivenOutOnTV(y) ∧ Rose(y)) ::: On some Mondays at 8 pm, roses are given out on TV.
∀y (GivenOutOnTV(y) ∧ Rose(y) → OnBachelor(y)) ::: Every rose given out on TV is on the Bachelor.
∀w (PortraysRealPeople(w) → RealityTV(w)) ::: Everything portraying the lives of real people is a reality TV show.
¬RealityTV(BreakingBad) ::: Breaking Bad is not a reality TV show.
Conclusion:
MondayAt8PM(x) ∧ GivenOutOnTV(y) ∧ Rose(y) ∧ OnBachelor(y) ::: Breaking Bad is on Monday at 8 pm.
